role: Software Developer responsible for creating and maintaining custom reports using FastReport and SQL-backed data preparation based on logistics business requirements.

sections.title: Project Context
sections.body: Logistics and import-export teams need reports that match business workflows, document requirements, and operational review needs. The reporting work focuses on producing practical outputs for real business users.

sections.title: Report Development
sections.body: I created custom FastReport reports based on business requirements and prepared SQL-backed data for report output. This required understanding the requested layout, validating data relationships, and adjusting report logic when requirements changed.

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.body: I supported bug fixing and report updates when business users found data, formatting, or workflow issues during UAT and operational use.
